response:
I'm so sorry. The loss you're describing carries an almost unbearable weight—not only losing the person you loved most, but losing him on a day that was supposed to mark your future together. That kind of grief doesn't follow a schedule, and it makes sense that a new town and a new life haven't erased it. Sometimes we carry the pain with us wherever we go, because the love was that real.

Please be gentle with yourself. There's no "handling it well"—there's only getting through, moment by moment. If the pain ever feels like too much to bear alone, reaching out to a grief counselor or a support group for people who've lost partners can help you feel less isolated in this. If you ever have thoughts of not wanting to be here, please call or text 988 (in the US) right away.

You loved him deeply. That love, and your grief, deserve care too.
